name: Meiotic double-strand break formation and recombination repair
rationale: All members concern initiation, repair and resolution of meiotic DSB-driven recombination in meiosis I, whereas confusables cover meiotic cohesion/segregation or mitotic DNA repair.

core: Checkpoint regulation of p53 and CDK activity
name: Checkpoint regulation of p53 stability and CDK activity
rationale: Members cover ubiquitin-mediated turnover of p53, COP1 and Cdc25A plus CDK inhibition and threonine dephosphorylation, while confusables emphasise p53 phosphorylation, radiation response and G2/M progression.

core: Mitochondrial protein import and membrane organization
name: Mitochondrial protein processing, degradation and cristae organization
rationale: Members share mitochondrial protein targeting, processing and turnover together with cristae and outer-membrane organization, unlike confusables centred on matrix/inner-membrane insertion or MCU calcium uptake.

name: Homologous recombination-based DNA repair and damage checkpoints
rationale: Members centre on strand invasion, SDSA, break-induced replication, recombination intermediate resolution and associated checkpoints, distinct from replication-fork stress, telomere or Fanconi-specific confusables.

qualifier: canonical destruction complex, non-canonical calcium branch, ligand secretion
name: Canonical and non-canonical Wnt signaling including ligand secretion
rationale: Members span the beta-catenin destruction complex and its cancer mutants, Wnt/Ca2+ signaling and Wnt ligand biogenesis, lacking the Notch, Hedgehog, Norrin-vascular or Hippo content of confusables.

name: Telomere capping, replication and recombination-based maintenance
rationale: All members concern telomere replication, D-loop/t-circle handling and capping against NHEJ, distinguishing them from general replication-stress and telomere-packaging confusables.

name: Proteasome assembly and degron-directed proteasomal degradation
rationale: Members centre on the proteasome, its assembly and N-end/C-end degron and ubiquitin-independent degradation, whereas confusables concern ubiquitin chain types, deubiquitinases, ERAD or aggrephagy.

qualifier: optic nerve and ganglion cell axons
name: Embryonic eye morphogenesis including optic nerve formation
rationale: Members cover morphogenesis of optic cup, retina, iris, eyelid and optic nerve with ganglion cell axon guidance, unlike confusables on lens, photoreceptors or inner ear.

name: Hematopoietic progenitor homeostasis and thymic T cell development
rationale: Members regulate bone marrow progenitor homeostasis and lymphoid differentiation, with thymocyte proliferation, survival and selection distinguishing the theme from stem-cell-division and myeloid confusables.

core: Bacterial TLR signaling and inflammatory cytokine production
name: TLR2/4 and inflammasome control of inflammatory cytokine production
rationale: Members combine LPS/lipopeptide TLR2/4 signaling with NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome IL-1 processing and cytokine production control, which TRIF-, NOD- and monocyte-module confusables lack.

name: Translation initiation via eIF3 and start codon scanning
rationale: All members concern assembly of the cytoplasmic initiation complex with eIF3 and scanning to the start codon, unlike termination, rRNA processing or elongation confusables.

name: HSF1-mediated heat shock response and its attenuation
rationale: All members concern HSF1 activation, attenuation and regulation of the cellular response to heat, distinct from senescence, p53 and stress-granule confusables.

name: PAPS sulfation metabolism and chondrodysplasia-causing transporter defects
rationale: Members concern PAPS synthesis and transport for sulfation and its inherited skeletal dysplasias, distinct from nucleotide-sugar transport, GAG biosynthesis and selenium confusables.

name: Anaphase spindle midzone and Rho-driven cytokinesis
rationale: Members cover spindle midzone assembly, spindle elongation and Rho-regulated cytokinesis, whereas confusables concern the spindle checkpoint, PLK1/AURKA and centrosome separation.

name: Neuropeptide control of sleep, stress and social behaviors
rationale: Members link neuropeptide (orexin, relaxin, CRH) signaling to sleep/wake, stress, mating, parental and aggressive behavior, unlike opioid synaptic signaling or HPA hormone secretion confusables.

core: Neural control of motor and social behavior
name: Locomotor, sensorimotor and social behavior with inhibitory neurotransmission
rationale: Members are locomotor, sensory, vocal and social behaviors with motor-circuit development and glycinergic/GABA inhibition, distinct from MECP2-centred, excitability and neurotrophic confusables.

qualifier: IRF3 activation and necroptotic cell death
name: TLR3-TRIF signaling to IRF3 and necroptotic cell death
rationale: Members concern endosomal TLR3/TRIF signaling to TBK1-IRF3, its HSE-causing deficiencies and RIPK1/ZBP1 necroptosis, which TAK1/IKK, interferon-response and RNA-editing confusables lack.

core: TLR2/4 bacterial lipid sensing and inflammation
name: Monocyte TLR2/4 bacterial lipid sensing and inflammation
rationale: Members combine LPS/lipopeptide TLR2/4-MyD88 signaling with monocyte/myeloid inflammatory modules, lacking the NOD1/2 and inflammasome/IL-1 content of confusables.

name: Gamma-chain, beta-common and gp130 cytokine JAK-STAT signaling
rationale: Members cover IL-2/7/9, IL-3/5 and IL-6/LIF/CNTF receptor signaling via STAT and ERK, distinct from IL-27/35, EPO/FLT3, IL-11 and IL-10/12/23 confusables.

name: COPI retrograde and endosome-Golgi-lysosome vesicle traffic
rationale: Members cover COPI intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER retrograde transport plus endosome-Golgi and Golgi-lysosome traffic, unlike COPII export, secretion or endosomal recycling confusables.

core: Integrin and Rho GTPase signaling in adhesion
name: Integrin-Rap1 and G12/13-Rho signaling linked to MAPK
rationale: Members combine integrin/Rap1 adhesion signaling, G12/13-Rho GPCR signaling and integrin-MAPK/ERK5 linkage, which platelet-agonist, focal-adhesion and shear-stress confusables lack.

name: Sema3A-mediated axon repulsion and collateral sprouting control
rationale: Members concern Sema3A/plexin/CRMP repulsion and regulation of axon extension, branching and collateral sprouting, unlike netrin, ephrin/Sema4D and injury-regeneration confusables.

name: Triglyceride synthesis, lipid droplet storage and lipolysis
rationale: Members cover DAG/PA and triglyceride synthesis, lipid droplet formation, lipophagy and lipolysis regulation, distinct from phospholipid remodeling, fatty acid oxidation and adipocyte differentiation confusables.

qualifier: protein import and very-long-chain fatty acid oxidation
name: Peroxisomal protein import and very-long-chain fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members combine peroxisomal matrix/membrane protein import and fission with VLCFA beta-oxidation, unlike medium-chain fatty acid or pexophagy confusables.

name: Oncogenic RAS and RAF mutant MAPK activation
rationale: Members concern MAPK activation by RAS, BRAF and RAF1 mutants including paradoxical activation, unlike confusables on MAPK negative feedback or MRAS/SHOC2-dependent RAF activation.
